html:
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the examination calendar for the academic year 2024-25. The calendar includes the dates for some of the most popular entrance examinations in India, such as JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET UG, CUET PG, and UGC NET.

Here is a summary of the key dates from the NTA examination calendar:

JEE Main 2024 Session 1: January 24-February 1, 2024
JEE Main 2024 Session 2: April 1-15, 2024
NEET UG 2024: May 5, 2024
CUET UG 2024: May 15-31, 2024
CUET PG 2024: March 11-28, 2024
UGC NET Session 1 2024: June 10-21, 2024
All of the CBT examinations will be conducted in computer-based mode. The NEET UG 2024 examination will be conducted in pen-and-paper mode.


 

The NTA will release more details about each examination, such as the eligibility criteria, syllabus, and exam pattern, in the coming months. Candidates are advised to visit the official NTA website (www.nta.ac.in) regularly for updates.

The release of the NTA examination calendar is a significant event for students who are planning to appear for entrance examinations in the upcoming academic year. The calendar provides them with a clear roadmap of the important dates and events, so that they can start their preparation accordingly.

It is important to note that the NTA examination calendar is subject to change. However, it is a good starting point for students to plan their preparation. Students should also keep in mind that the NTA releases detailed information about each examination, such as the eligibility criteria, syllabus, and exam pattern, in the coming months. It is important for students to read and understand this information carefully before they start their preparation.

Here are some tips for students who are preparing for entrance examinations:

Start your preparation early. The earlier you start, the more time you will have to cover the syllabus and practice for the examination.
Create a study plan and stick to it. A study plan will help you to stay organized and on track.
Use quality study materials. There are many good study materials available, both online and offline. Choose the materials that are best suited for your learning style.
Practice regularly. The more you practice, the better prepared you will be for the examination.
Take breaks. It is important to take breaks while studying to avoid burnout.
Stay positive and motivated. Preparing for entrance examinations can be challenging, but it is important to stay positive and motivated. Remember that your hard work will pay off in the end.
I hope this blog post is helpful. All the best for your preparation!
